pages.text: $(bold)Stock Keeper Card$(): keeps the bound inventory topped up to one stack of whatever the router is carrying, and stops when it is full. Craft it with Bandwidth Upgrades to keep 2 / 4 / 8 stacks.
It never fetches anything by itself - pair it with an item card in $(bold)EXTRACT$() mode on a chest. That one fills the router buffer, this one keeps the machine stocked.
